variables.name: PORT
variables.description: HTTP listen port. Calnode defaults to 3000; Railway maps the public domain to this port.

variables.name: BASE_URL
variables.description: Public identity host — the URL your team and bookers use (e.g. https://book.example.com or https://<domain>.up.railway.app). Drives OAuth callbacks, admin UI, and invite links. Set your real domain after the first deploy and redeploy.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: SQLite driver location. SQLite is the only store (pure-Go, no CGO, no Postgres). Keep the /data path — it is on the calnode-data volume.

variables.name: CALNODE_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: Envelope-encryption master key (auto-generated). Required for production. Rotatable later with `calnode rotate-key`.

variables.name: CALNODE_RECOVERY_SECRET
variables.description: Optional break-glass escrow for recovering from a lost CALNODE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

variables.name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
variables.description: Optional booker-facing host (blank = inherits BASE_URL).

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Timezone for meetings, reminders, logs. e.g. America/New_York.

variables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Optional Google OAuth client ID. Add redirect {BASE_URL}/v1/auth/callback + {BASE_URL}/v1/calendar/callback.

variables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Optional Google OAuth client secret.

variables.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Optional Microsoft 365 / Outlook client ID (Azure App registration).

variables.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Optional Microsoft client secret.

variables.name: MICROSOFT_TENANT
variables.description: Microsoft tenant; 'common' = personal + work/school. Set a tenant ID to restrict to your org.

variables.name: EMAIL_SMTP_HOST
variables.description: Optional SMTP host for booking invitation / confirmation emails. Blank = no email.

variables.name: EMAIL_SMTP_PORT
variables.description: Optional SMTP port (587 STARTTLS default).

variables.name: EMAIL_SMTP_USER
variables.description: Optional SMTP username.

variables.name: EMAIL_SMTP_PASS
variables.description: Optional SMTP password.

variables.name: EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS
variables.description: Optional From address, e.g. bookings@yourdomain.com.

variables.name: EMAIL_FROM_NAME
variables.description: Optional sender display name.

variables.name: LITESTREAM_REPLICA_URL
variables.description: Optional S3 bucket for continuous SQLite backups (Litestream) + meeting recordings. e.g. s3://bucket/calnode. Blank = local volume only.

variables.name: LITESTREAM_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.description: Optional S3 access key (pair with LITESTREAM_REPLICA_URL).

variables.name: LITESTREAM_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
variables.description: Optional S3 secret key (pair with LITESTREAM_REPLICA_URL).

variables.name: LITESTREAM_ENDPOINT
variables.description: Optional S3 endpoint host. Required for non-AWS providers (R2, B2, MinIO).

variables.name: LITESTREAM_REGION
variables.description: Optional S3 region.
